native.scope: Persistent favorite cache, observation, editor, transport and session lifecycle

UI.scope: Slow asynchronous save, uncertain result checking, add, move, note, removal, list refresh, read failure, dark appearance and large text

controlled_measurements.environment: Isolated iOS Simulator fixtures; not real-site or physical-device latency

change.unknown_submission_result: Read only; no automatic duplicate POST
change.known_unsent_failure: Retain queued intent; continue on revisit or foreground
change.automatic_refresh: Visible stale records only, on access or foreground; no continuous polling

limitations: State survives restart; forms do not. The first edit after restart requires a fresh form read.
After restart, pending items resume when the corresponding gallery is revisited, because request references remain memory-only.
Cached status is the latest local view, not a guarantee against changes made by another client. Only server readback confirms synchronization.
No real-site favorite mutation or physical-device latency was exercised by these isolated tests.
The previously reported individual gallery response remains unavailable; its root cause is separate from this favorite change.
Installation readback and real-device UI or account acceptance remain separate evidence surfaces.
